events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British actor and comedian John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From 'Fawlty Towers' to 'Monty Python', his genius has given us endless laughs. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: On this day in 1968, The Beatles released their ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album'.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles unleashed their iconic 'White Album' on the world. Double album, no title, pure genius. Which track is your go-to?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Legendary Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice, his showmanship, his legacy. He would have been 80 this year, still rocking the world.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul'.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that showed their evolution. What's your favourite from this classic?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Lennon Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years since we lost a true visionary. His music and message continue to inspire generations. He would have been 86 today.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today would have been the 80th birthday of the iconic 'Starman', David Bowie, who passed away in 2016.

angles.name: Bowie's Legacy
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. A true innovator whose influence still echoes through music and culture.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: King's Birthday
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have turned 92 today. His impact on music is undeniable. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist and producer, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page! The architect of Led Zeppelin's sound and one of rock's most influential guitarists.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British rock and pop singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Raise a glass! The legendary Rod Stewart turns 82 today. From rock anthems to timeless ballads, what's your top Rod moment?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Nutty Boy Birthday
angles.copy: It's the 66th birthday of the one and only Suggs from Madness! Forever bringing the good times and the 'nutty sound'. What's your favourite Madness hit?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: The 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' singer Paul Young, known for his distinctive blue-eyed soul voice, celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Blue-Eyed Soul
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the brilliant Paul Young! His voice defined an era. What's the Paul Young track that always gets you?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Today would have been the 81st birthday of the beloved country music legend Dolly Parton, who passed away in August 2026.

angles.name: Tribute to Dolly
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. Her music, her heart, her legacy – truly one of a kind.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Maestro
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the pop maestro, Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo hits, his songs have soundtracked decades. What's your favourite?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: The Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for hits like 'Caribbean Queen' and 'When the Going Gets Tough, the Tough Get Going', celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Soulful Seventies
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean! His smooth vocals and infectious grooves are timeless. What's your favourite Billy Ocean classic?

events.title: First Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring legends like The Beatles, Elvis Presley, and Bob Dylan.

angles.name: Rock History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, rock history was made with the first ever Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction! A monumental day for music. Who do you think should be inducted next?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That singer-songwriter Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, his charm is undeniable. What's your favourite Mark Owen song?

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary and final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rock
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. What a way to go out! Imagine being there!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: The acclaimed English singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins, known for his solo hits and work with Genesis, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Music Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A true powerhouse behind the drums and on the mic. What's your favourite Phil Collins or Genesis track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake, who rose to fame with NSYNC before a hugely successful solo career, celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband phenomenon to solo superstar, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'. What's your favourite JT hit?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: The beloved English actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles as Del Boy in 'Only Fools and Horses' and Jack Frost in 'A Touch of Frost', celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to a true national treasure, Sir David Jason! From Peckham to Poplar, he's given us some of the most iconic characters in British TV history. Lovely jubbly!
